summary: Not as a dip signal. On BTC, ETH and SOL, price after CCI(20) went below −100, or crossed back up through −100, did no better than after random candles on 1h, 4h or daily. The result that holds up is narrow: on daily, in uptrends, price after a cross up through +100 ran 5.59% ahead of random entries 20 days later, and stayed ahead without its strongest stretch.

verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily, either as a level below −100 or as a cross back up through −100.
Nothing on 1h or 4h. On daily it beat random entries, but the pooled result needs one stretch of signals. It held up only in uptrends.
Worse than random on 4h and daily, because price kept rising after the reading. Each result rests on one stretch of entries, and on daily it comes from uptrends.
Barely above the luck band on 1h, and only because of three entries on May 18–19, 2021. Inside the band on 4h and daily.

notes: On 1h, CCI(20) below −100 gave 30,603 entries in 2,522 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.03% ahead of random entries, inside a luck band of −0.08% to 0.11%. The cross back up through −100 enters about a quarter as often and landed at 0. Both stayed inside the band on 4h and daily, in uptrends and in downtrends.

On daily, price after CCI(20) crossed up through +100 was 3.08% ahead of random entries 20 days later. That pooled result needs the entries between Jan 1, 2021 and Mar 27, 2021, and without them it is chance. In uptrends the cross was 5.59% ahead. It held without its strongest stretch and showed at 10, 20 and 50 candles, but not at 100. In downtrends it was 2.06% behind, inside the band.
The pooled daily result also leans on SOL. SOL was 7.44% ahead, ETH 3.08% ahead, and BTC 0.36% behind, inside its band. On 1h and 4h the same cross showed nothing on any pair.

Shorting while CCI(20) was above +100 did 0.25% worse than random on 4h and 4.52% worse after 20 days on daily. The 4h result needs 130 entries between Jul 22, 2021 and Sep 9, 2021. The daily one needs 72 entries between Jan 1, 2021 and May 18, 2021. On SOL daily the 11.15% gap holds even without that stretch. The weakness comes from uptrends: on daily the up regime was 5.16% worse, while the down regime was 1.37% ahead, inside the band.

On 1h, the short after a cross down through +100 was 0.09% ahead of random, just above a band ending at 0.08%. Three entries on May 18–19, 2021, around the May 19, 2021 crypto crash, carry it. Without them it is chance, and it was chance at 10, 50 and 100 candles too. On 4h and daily the cross showed nothing.

For a long DCA bot, CCI dips below −100 add nothing on these pairs, so the DCA orders and take profit do the work. The one shape to test is the daily cross up through +100 as a filter beside a trend condition, since it only held while the pair was above its 200-day SMA. It breaks in downtrends, where it fell behind random. For a short bot, readings above +100 marked continuation in uptrends, which is a reason to leave that start condition out.
